editorial.intro: Explore Cessna aircraft clipart featuring Skyhawk and Caravan propeller planes, Citation jets and other general aviation illustrations.
paragraphs: Follow the strut from wing to fuselage on a Cessna Skyhawk, then look for the jet engines on a Citation. The contrast makes this Cessna aircraft clipart useful for showing the range from light training aircraft to business jets.

The {{artworkCount}} illustrations also include Caravan aircraft and twin engine Cessna designs. For a flight school handout, pair a clear propeller plane profile with a jet outline and give each aircraft room for a short label.
